en.s: The Battle of Lüneburg Heath (also called the Battle of Ebstorf) was a conflict between the army of King Louis III of France and the Norse Great Heathen Army fought on 2 February 880 AD, at Lüneburg Heath in Saxony. Following defeat by Alfred the Great at the Battle of Edington, the Norse Great Heathen Army moved from England to pillage Saxony.

zh.s: 吕讷堡荒原战役又称埃布斯托夫战役，发生于公元880年2月2日萨克森的吕讷堡荒原，交战双方为法国国王路易三世的军队与北欧异教徒大军。北欧大军此前在埃丁顿战役中败给阿尔弗雷德大帝，随后离开英格兰，转往萨克森劫掠。

en.t: Otto I crowned emperor at Old St. Peter’s
en.s: On 2 February 962, Pope John XII crowned Otto I emperor at Old St. Peter’s Basilica in Rome, on the site now within Vatican City.

zh.t: 奥托一世在旧圣彼得大教堂加冕为皇帝
zh.s: 962年2月2日，教皇若望十二世在罗马旧圣彼得大教堂为奥托一世加冕。教堂旧址位于今梵蒂冈境内。

en.s: The Battle of Barry is a legendary battle in which the Scots, purportedly led by Malcolm II, defeated a Danish invasion force in 1010 AD. Its supposed site in Carnoustie, Angus can be seen in early Ordnance Survey maps. The history of the event relies heavily on tradition and it is considered to be apocryphal.

zh.s: 巴里战役是一场传说中的战役，据称发生于公元1010年，苏格兰军队在马尔科姆二世率领下击败了丹麦入侵军。传说中的战场位于安格斯郡卡诺斯蒂，早期的英国地形测量局地图上可以看到这一地点。相关记载主要来自传统说法，这场战役通常被认为并非真实事件。

en.s: The Battle of Lincoln, or the First Battle of Lincoln, occurred on 2 February 1141 in Lincoln, England between King Stephen of England and forces loyal to Empress Matilda. Stephen was captured during the battle, imprisoned, and effectively deposed while Matilda ruled for a short time.

zh.s: 林肯战役又称第一次林肯战役，发生于1141年2月2日的英格兰林肯，交战双方为英王斯蒂芬及效忠玛蒂尔达皇后的军队。斯蒂芬在战斗中被俘并遭监禁，实际上失去王位，玛蒂尔达则短暂掌权。

en.t: Terra Mariana, eventually comprising present-day Latvia and Estonia, is established
en.s: Terra Mariana (Medieval Latin for 'Land of Mary') was the formal name for Medieval Livonia or Old Livonia. It was formed in the aftermath of the Livonian Crusade, and its territories were composed of present-day Estonia and Latvia. It was established on 2 February 1207, as a principality of the Holy Roman Empire, and lost this status in 1215 when Pope Innocent III proclaimed it as directly subject to the Holy See.

zh.t: 圣母之地建立，后来包括今拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚
zh.s: “圣母之地”（Terra Mariana，中世纪拉丁语，意为“圣母之地”）是中世纪利沃尼亚或古利沃尼亚的正式名称。它在利沃尼亚十字军东征后建立，领土包括今爱沙尼亚和拉脱维亚。1207年2月2日，它作为神圣罗马帝国的一个公国建立；1215年，教宗英诺森三世宣布该地直属罗马教廷，公国地位随之终止。

en.s: The Battle of al-Kura (Egyptian Arabic: معركة الكورة) was a military clash in medieval Egypt between an army of the Mamluks ruling Egypt and an army of the Ayyubids ruling Syria. The battle occurred on February 2, 1251, on a stretch of land called al-Kura, near the town of al-Salihiyya on the eastern edge of the Nile Delta.

zh.s: 库拉战役（埃及阿拉伯语：معركة الكورة）是中世纪埃及马穆鲁克王朝军队与统治叙利亚的阿尤布王朝军队之间的一场军事冲突。战役于1251年2月2日在名为库拉的一片地区发生，地点靠近尼罗河三角洲东缘的萨利希耶镇。

en.s: Battle of Strėva, Strebe, or Strawe was fought on 2 February 1348 between the Teutonic Order and pagan Grand Duchy of Lithuania on the banks of the Strėva River, a right tributary of the Neman River, near present-day Žiežmariai. Chronicler Wigand of Marburg publicized this battle as a great victory for the Knights: he claims that some 18,000 Lithuanians were killed or drowned while only 8 knights and 60 other soldiers died on the Order's side. Narimantas and Manvydas, two sons of Gediminas, Grand Duke of Lithuania, are thought to be killed in the battle.

zh.s: 1348年2月2日，条顿骑士团与仍信奉传统宗教的立陶宛大公国，在今天日耶日马里艾附近的斯特雷瓦河畔交战。斯特雷瓦河是尼曼河右岸支流。编年史作者马尔堡的维甘德将其宣扬为骑士团大捷，声称约18000名立陶宛人阵亡或溺死，而骑士团仅损失八名骑士和60名其他士兵。立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的两个儿子纳里曼塔斯和曼维达斯，据认为也在战斗中身亡。

en.s: The Catalan earthquake of 2 February 1428, known in Catalan as the terratrèmol de la candelera because it took place during Candlemas, struck the Principality of Catalonia, especially Roussillon, with an epicentre near Camprodon. The earthquake was one of a series of related seismic events that shook Catalonia in a single year. Beginning on 23 February 1427, tremors were felt in March, April, 15 May at Olot, June, and December.

zh.s: 1428年2月2日发生的加泰罗尼亚地震，在加泰罗尼亚语中称为“烛光节地震”，因为地震发生在烛光节当天。地震袭击了加泰罗尼亚公国，鲁西永受灾尤为严重，震中靠近坎普罗东。这是当年震动加泰罗尼亚的一系列相关地震之一。此前，地震活动始于1427年2月23日，之后在3月、4月、5月15日奥洛特、6月和12月也有震感。

en.s: The Transylvanian peasant revolt (Hungarian: erdélyi parasztfelkelés), also known as the Bábolna revolt (Romanian: Răscoala de la Bobâlna) was a popular revolt in the eastern territories of the Kingdom of Hungary in 1437. The revolt broke out after George Lépes, bishop of Transylvania, had failed to collect the tithe for years because of a temporary debasement of the coinage, but then demanded the arrears in one sum when coins of higher value were again issued.
en.n: Nine leaders of the Transylvanian peasant revolt are executed at Torda.

zh.t: 特兰西瓦尼亚农民起义
zh.s: 特兰西瓦尼亚农民起义又称巴博尔瑙起义（匈牙利语：erdélyi parasztfelkelés；罗马尼亚语：Răscoala de la Bobâlna），是1437年匈牙利王国东部地区发生的一场民众起义。此前，特兰西瓦尼亚主教乔治·莱佩什因货币暂时贬值，多年来一直未能收取什一税；待高面值货币重新发行后，他却要求一次性补缴多年欠税。
zh.n: 特兰西瓦尼亚农民起义的9名领袖在托尔达被处决。

en.s: The Battle of Mortimer's Cross was fought on 2 February 1461 near Wigmore, Herefordshire (between Leominster and Leintwardine, by the River Lugg), not far from the Welsh border. It was a major battle of the Wars of the Roses. The opposing forces were an army led by Jasper Tudor and his father, Owen Tudor, and other nobles loyal to the King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster, his Queen Margaret of Anjou and their seven-year-old son Edward, Prince of Wales on one side, and the army of Edward, Earl of March.

zh.s: 1461年2月2日，莫蒂默十字之战发生在英格兰赫里福德郡威格莫尔附近，位于莱明斯特与莱因特沃丁之间、拉格河畔，距威尔士边界不远。这是玫瑰战争的一场重要战役。一方由贾斯珀·都铎及其父欧文·都铎等贵族率军，效忠兰开斯特家族国王亨利六世、安茹的玛格丽特王后及两人七岁的儿子、威尔士亲王爱德华；另一方则是马奇伯爵爱德华的军队。

en.t: Mendoza establishes the first Spanish settlement at Buenos Aires
en.s: On 2 February 1536, Pedro de Mendoza established the first Spanish settlement at Buenos Aires, in present-day Argentina. This was the early colonial settlement, distinct from the later refounding.

zh.t: 门多萨建立布宜诺斯艾利斯最初的西班牙殖民点
zh.s: 1536年2月2日，佩德罗·德·门多萨在今阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯建立最初的西班牙殖民点，区别于后来重新建城。

en.s: The Battle of Baçente was fought on February 2, 1542 when a Portuguese army under Cristóvão da Gama took a hillfort held by Adalite forces in northern Ethiopia. The Portuguese suffered minimal casualties, while the defenders were reportedly all killed. Queen Sabla Wengel advised against this attack, arguing that Gama should wait until her son the Emperor Gelawdewos could march north from Shewa and join the Portuguese. However, Gama was concerned that if he marched around this Muslim-held strongpoint, the local peasantry would be disappointed and stop providing supplies for his troops.

zh.s: 1542年2月2日，克里斯托旺·达·伽马率葡萄牙军队，攻占埃塞俄比亚北部由阿达尔军队据守的一座山堡。葡军伤亡极少，守军据报全部被杀。萨布拉·文格尔王后曾反对进攻，认为伽马应等她的儿子、皇帝格拉德沃斯从绍阿北上，与葡军会合。但伽马担心，如果绕过这处穆斯林控制的据点，当地农民会失望，不再给他的部队提供补给。

en.s: The Portuguese conquest of Daman was a military campaign undertaken by the Portuguese Empire against the city of Daman, in India, until then owned by the Sultanate of Gujarat. The Portuguese captured the city.

zh.s: 葡萄牙征服达曼是葡萄牙帝国为夺取印度达曼城而发动的一场军事行动。当时达曼由古吉拉特苏丹国控制，最终被葡萄牙人攻占。

en.s: The Battle of Talandongo was a military conflict between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo.

zh.s: 塔兰东戈战役是葡萄牙王国与恩东戈王国之间的一场军事冲突。

en.s: Battle of Piatka (Ukrainian: П'ятка, Polish: Piątka, Piątek), (February 2, 1593) was a battle of the Kosiński Uprising. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Janusz Ostrogski defeated the Cossacks forces under the command of Krzysztof Kosiński.

zh.s: 1593年2月2日，科辛斯基起义期间发生皮亚特卡战役。雅努什·奥斯特罗格斯基率领的波兰立陶宛联邦军队，击败了克日什托夫·科辛斯基指挥的哥萨克军队。

en.s: The Battle of Inverlochy (2 February 1645) was a battle of the Scottish Civil War in which Montrose routed the pursuing forces of the Marquess of Argyll. The battlefield is currently under research to be inventoried and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009. On 14 January 1645, having sacked Inverary, the seat of the Campbells of Argyll, the Royalist forces left Inverary and headed north. It is believed that Montrose split his army at Glen Etive sending part of it up past Ballachulish while the bulk continued across Rannoch Moor, into Glencoe.

zh.s: 1645年2月2日，苏格兰内战期间，蒙特罗斯在因弗洛奇击溃了追赶他的阿盖尔侯爵部队。原文记载，苏格兰历史局正依据2009年《苏格兰历史环境政策》研究该战场，以将其列入名录并予以保护。1月14日，保王军洗劫阿盖尔坎贝尔家族的据点因弗雷里后离城北上。据认为，蒙特罗斯在埃蒂夫峡谷分兵，一部经巴拉胡利什向北，主力则穿过兰诺赫荒原进入格伦科。

en.s: The Battle of Surat took place on 2 February 1704, off Surat, India, Arabian Sea, when a Portuguese squadron of one ship of the line and seven frigates, commanded by D. António de Meneses, defeated an Omani squadron of nine ships of the line and frigates.

zh.s: 1704年2月2日，在印度苏拉特外海的阿拉伯海，安东尼奥·德·梅内塞斯率领由一艘战列舰和七艘护卫舰组成的葡萄牙舰队，击败了由九艘战列舰和护卫舰组成的阿曼舰队。

en.s: On 2 February 1725, Johann Sebastian Bach led the first performance of his cantata Mit Fried und Freud ich fahr dahin, BWV 125, in Leipzig, in present-day Germany, for the feast of Candlemas.

zh.s: 1725年2月2日，巴赫在今德国莱比锡指挥首演康塔塔《我平安喜乐地离去》（BWV 125），用于圣母献主节礼拜。

en.s: The Battle of Torrence's Tavern (also referred to as the Skirmish at Torrence's Tavern or the Battle at Tarrant's Tavern) was a minor engagement of the American Revolutionary War that took place in what was the western portion of Rowan County, North Carolina, approximately 10 miles (16 km) east of the Catawba River near modern-day Mooresville in Iredell County. Torrence's Tavern was a part of the larger Southern campaign of the American Revolution, which, by 1780–1781 involved a series of clashes between the British Army and Loyalist milita and the Continental Army and Patriot militia in the Piedmont region of North and South Carolina.

zh.s: 托伦斯酒馆战斗也称托伦斯酒馆冲突或塔兰特酒馆战斗，是美国独立战争的一场小规模交战。战场位于当时北卡罗来纳州罗恩县西部、卡托巴河以东约10英里（16公里），靠近今天艾尔德尔县的穆尔斯维尔。战斗属于美国独立战争南部战役的一部分。1780至1781年间，英军及效忠派民兵与大陆军及爱国者民兵，在南、北卡罗来纳的皮德蒙特地区多次交锋。

en.s: The first election for Virginia's 5th congressional district took place on February 2, 1789, for a two-year term to commence on March 4 of that year. In a race that turned on the candidates' positions on the need for amendments (the Bill of Rights) to the recently ratified U.S. Constitution, James Madison defeated James Monroe for a place in the House of Representatives of the First Congress.

zh.t: 1789年弗吉尼亚州第五国会选区选举
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州第五国会选区首次选举于1789年2月2日举行，选出任期两年的议员，任期从当年3月4日开始。此次竞选围绕是否需要为新近批准的美国宪法增列修正案（即《权利法案》）展开。詹姆斯·麦迪逊击败詹姆斯·门罗，赢得首届国会众议院席位。

en.s: The Second Battle of Makli (Sindhi: مڪلي واري ٻي جنگ) was fought during the Talpur dynasty's reign in Sindh between the Baloch Kalmat (Karmat) tribe and the Sindhi Jokhia tribe at the Makli site.

zh.s: 第二次马克利战役（信德语：مڪلي واري ٻي جنگ）发生于塔尔普尔王朝统治信德地区期间，交战双方是俾路支人卡尔马特（又称卡尔马特）部族和信德人乔希亚部族，战场位于马克利遗址。

en.s: On February 2, 1797, the Austrian garrison at Mantua, in present-day Italy, surrendered to French forces after a prolonged siege. Austrian commander Dagobert von Wurmser surrendered to General Jean-Mathieu-Philibert Sérurier.

zh.t: 曼图亚守军向法军投降
zh.s: 1797年2月2日，经过长期围困，今意大利曼图亚的奥地利守军向法军投降，奥军统帅达戈贝特·冯·武姆泽向法军将领塞律里埃交降。

en.s: USS Constellation vs La Vengeance, or the action of 1 February 1800, was a single-ship action fought between frigates of the French Navy and the United States Navy during the Quasi-War. In the battle the American frigate USS Constellation tried to take the French frigate La Vengeance as a prize. Both ships were heavily damaged.

zh.s: 星座号对阵复仇号，又称1800年2月1日海战，是准战争期间法国海军与美国海军护卫舰之间的一场单舰交战。美国护卫舰星座号试图俘获法国护卫舰复仇号，两舰均严重受损。

en.s: The Battle of Lesmont was a battle of the War of the Sixth Coalition. It took place at Lesmont in Aube on 2 February 1814. A Coalition force of Russians and Bavarians under generals Eugen of Wurtemberg and Carl Philipp von Wrede was defeated by a French force under general Joseph Lagrange, which managed to destroy the town's bridge and prevent the Coalition force crossing the river Aube.

zh.s: 莱斯蒙战役是第六次反法同盟战争中的一场战役，于1814年2月2日在奥布省莱斯蒙发生。符腾堡的欧根和卡尔·菲利普·冯·韦德率领俄军与巴伐利亚军组成的联军被约瑟夫·拉格朗日率领的法军击败。法军成功摧毁了当地桥梁，阻止联军渡过奥布河。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in the Federal Republic of Central America on 2 February 1835 following the unexpected death of president-elect José Cecilio del Valle during a journey from his native Honduras and the Federation’s capital in Guatemala to take the oath. Valle had been elected in June 1934 and was due to take office in 1935. The elections saw former president and Liberal leader Francisco Morazán win virtually unopposed. However, they were to be the last elections in the Federation, as it was dissolved in 1939, before the end of Morazán's term in office.

zh.s: 中美洲联邦共和国于1835年2月2日提前举行总统选举。当选总统何塞·塞西利奥·德尔巴列从家乡洪都拉斯前往危地马拉的联邦首都宣誓就职途中意外去世，因而重新选举。前总统、自由派领袖弗朗西斯科·莫拉桑几乎在没有对手的情况下获胜。这是联邦最后一次选举，联邦在莫拉桑任期结束前解体。原文另称巴列于1934年6月当选、1935年拟就任，联邦于1939年解体，这几处年份与本文1835年的选举时间明显不符。

en.s: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo officially ended the Mexican–American War (1846–1848). It was signed on the 2nd of February 1848 in the town of Guadalupe Hidalgo. After the defeat of its army and the fall of the capital in September 1847, Mexico entered into peace negotiations with the U.S. envoy, Nicholas Trist.
en.n: Mexican–American War: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo is signed.

zh.t: 瓜达卢佩·伊达尔戈条约
zh.s: 《瓜达卢佩·伊达尔戈条约》正式结束了美墨战争（1846—1848年）。条约于1848年2月2日在瓜达卢佩·伊达尔戈镇签署。1847年9月墨西哥军队战败、首都陷落后，墨西哥开始与美国特使尼古拉斯·特里斯进行和平谈判。
zh.n: 美墨战争：《瓜达卢佩·伊达尔戈条约》签署。

en.s: The Mexican–American War, also known in the United States as the Mexican War and in Mexico as the United States intervention in Mexico, (April 25, 1846 – February 2, 1848) was an invasion of Mexico by the United States. It followed the 1845 American annexation of Texas, which Mexico still considered its territory because it refused to recognize the Treaties of Velasco, signed by President Antonio López de Santa Anna after he was captured by the Texian Army during the 1836 Texas Revolution.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 美墨战争在美国也称墨西哥战争，在墨西哥则称美国干涉墨西哥战争，持续时间为1846年4月25日至1848年2月2日。这场战争是美国对墨西哥的入侵，起因之一是美国于1845年吞并得克萨斯。墨西哥仍将得克萨斯视为本国领土，因为墨西哥拒绝承认《贝拉斯科条约》；该条约由安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳总统于1836年得克萨斯革命期间被得克萨斯军队俘虏后签署。

en.s: The Provo River Massacre (also known as the Battle at Fort Utah, or Fort Utah Massacre) was a violent attack and massacre in 1850 in which 90 Mormon militiamen surrounded an encampment of Timpanogos families on the Provo River, and laid siege for two days. They eventually shot between 40 and 100 Native American men and one woman with guns and a cannon during the siege and subsequent pursuit, capture, and execution of the two groups that fled during the last night.
en.n: Brigham Young declares war on Timpanogos in the Battle at Fort Utah.

zh.s: 普罗沃河屠杀又称犹他堡战役或犹他堡屠杀。1850年，90名摩门教民兵包围了普罗沃河边提姆帕诺戈斯人的营地并围困两天。这场袭击最终导致40至100名美洲原住民男子和一名女子遭枪支及大炮射杀；期间还追捕、抓获并处决了在最后一夜逃离营地的两批人。
zh.n: 杨百翰在犹他堡战役期间向提姆帕诺戈斯人宣战。

en.s: The Battle of La Arada (Spanish: Batalla de la Arada) was fought on 2 February 1851 near the town of Chiquimula in Guatemala, between the forces of Guatemala and an Allied army from Honduras and El Salvador. As the most serious threat to Guatemala's liberty and sovereignty as a republic, it was the most important military victory in the country's history as an independent state.

zh.s: 1851年2月2日，危地马拉军队与洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多联军在危地马拉奇基穆拉镇附近交战。联军对危地马拉共和国的自由和主权构成严重威胁，因此拉阿拉达之战被视为该国独立后历史上最重要的军事胜利。

The Prussian vanguard force of 10,000 men attempted to break through and outflank the Danish defenses at the Danevirke, but were repulsed by the fortification garrison and two battalions of the Danish army.

en.s: The Battle of Broxton Bridge took place during the American Civil War on February 2, 1865, and coincided with the Battle of Rivers' Bridge along the Salkehatchie River in Bamberg County, South Carolina. The battle concluded in a Union victory and resulted in the destruction of the last Confederate defensive line before the Union Army went on to Capture Columbia and burn it later that month.

zh.s: 1865年2月2日，美国内战期间发生布罗克斯顿桥战役，同时南卡罗来纳州班贝格县萨尔克哈奇河沿线还进行了里弗斯桥战役。联邦军获胜，摧毁了联盟军最后一道防线；此后联邦军继续推进，并于当月攻占、焚毁哥伦比亚。

en.t: First installment of Seven Brothers published
en.s: On 2 February 1870, the first of four installments of Aleksis Kivi’s novel Seven Brothers was published for subscribers in Finland. The bound-book edition followed later.

en.s: The Battle of Pontarlier, also known as the Battle of Pontarlier-La Cluse, was the final military operation of the Franco-Prussian War, that took place from 29 January to 2 February 1871, near Pontarlier and La Cluse-et-Mijoux, not long after the newly formed German Empire and French Republic had a ceasefire.

en.s: The 1889 Scottish Cup final, colloquially known as the Snow final, was a football match played on 2 February 1889 at Hampden Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) and was the final of the 16th staging of the Scottish Cup. Celtic and Third Lanark (then know officially as 3rd Lanarkshire Rifle Volunteers) contested the match. Third Lanark won the match 3–0.

zh.s: 1889年苏格兰杯决赛是一场足球比赛，俗称“雪战决赛”，于1889年2月2日在克罗斯希尔的汉普顿公园举行，该地如今属于格拉斯哥。决赛是第16届苏格兰杯赛事的最后一场，由凯尔特人队对阵第三拉纳克队（当时的正式名称为第三拉纳克郡步枪志愿军）。第三拉纳克队以3比0获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Marracuene (Portuguese: Combate de Marracuene), also known as the Battle of Gwaza Muthini, was a military confrontation that was fought on February 2, 1895, near Marracuene, Portuguese Mozambique, between Ronga rebels and Portuguese forces. There were over 2,000 Ronga troops in the conflict. António Enes, the Portuguese Royal Commissioner, assembled over 2,000 European soldiers. The Portuguese, armed with machine guns and repeating rifles, won the confrontation.

zh.s: 马拉夸内战役又称瓜扎穆蒂尼战役（葡萄牙语：Combate de Marracuene），于1895年2月2日在葡属莫桑比克的马拉夸内附近爆发，交战双方是隆加族起义者和葡萄牙军队。隆加族一方出动了2000多人，葡萄牙王室专员安东尼奥·恩内斯集结了2000多名欧洲士兵。葡萄牙军队装备机枪和连发步枪，最终获胜。

en.s: The 1907 British Columbia general election was the eleventh general election for the Province of British Columbia, Canada. It was held to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of British Columbia. The election called on December 24, 1906, and held on February 2, 1907. The new legislature met for the first time on March 7, 1907.

zh.s: 1907年不列颠哥伦比亚省大选是加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的第11次大选，选举该省立法议会议员。选举令于1906年12月24日发布，投票于1907年2月2日举行。新一届议会于1907年3月7日首次召开。

en.s: The Paris Film Congress was a major meeting of European film producers and distributors in the French capital Paris from 2–4 February 1909. It intended to create an association to protect the interests of the participants through the formation of a trade organisation, a plan that ultimately failed. Amongst the major companies taking part were Pathé, Gaumont and Éclair of France, Cines and Ambrosio Film of Italy, Messter Film of Germany, Hepworth Pictures of Britain and Nordisk of Denmark.

zh.s: 1909年2月2日至4日，欧洲电影制片商和发行商在法国首都巴黎举行重要会议，计划成立行业组织，以维护参会者利益，但最终未能成功。主要参会公司包括法国的百代、高蒙和埃克莱尔，意大利的奇内斯和安布罗西奥电影公司，德国的梅斯特电影公司，英国的赫普沃思影业，以及丹麦的北欧电影公司。

en.t: Estonia and Soviet Russia sign the Treaty of Tartu
en.s: On 2 February 1920, Estonia and Soviet Russia signed the Treaty of Tartu in Tartu, Estonia, ending the Estonian War of Independence. Soviet Russia recognized Estonia’s independence and sovereignty.

zh.s: 1920年2月2日，爱沙尼亚与苏维埃俄国在爱沙尼亚塔尔图签订和约，结束爱沙尼亚独立战争。苏维埃俄国承认爱沙尼亚的独立和主权。

en.s: The Clonfin Ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 2 February 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place in the townland of Clonfin (or Cloonfin) between Ballinalee and Granard in County Longford. The IRA ambushed two lorries carrying members of the British Auxiliary Division, sparking a lengthy gun battle in which four Auxiliaries were killed and eight wounded.

zh.s: 1921年2月2日，爱尔兰共和军（IRA）在爱尔兰独立战争期间发动克隆芬伏击战。战斗发生在朗福德郡巴利纳利和格拉纳德之间的克隆芬（也称Cloonfin）镇区。爱尔兰共和军伏击了两辆载有英国辅助师成员的卡车，随后双方展开长时间枪战，4名辅助师成员死亡，8人受伤。

en.t: Ulysses by James Joyce is published
en.s: Ulysses is a modernist novel by the Irish writer James Joyce. Partially serialised in the American journal The Little Review from March 1918 to December 1920, the entire work was published in Paris by Sylvia Beach on 2 February 1922, Joyce's fortieth birthday. It is considered one of the most important works of modernist literature and a classic of the genre, having been called "a demonstration and summation of the entire movement".

zh.t: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《尤利西斯》出版
zh.s: 《尤利西斯》是爱尔兰作家詹姆斯·乔伊斯创作的一部现代主义小说。作品曾于1918年3月至1920年12月在美国杂志《小评论》连载，完整版本于1922年2月2日在巴黎由西尔维娅·比奇出版；当天也是乔伊斯的40岁生日。该书被视为现代主义文学的重要作品和这一流派的经典，曾被评价为“对整个运动的展示与总结”。

en.s: The Second Honduran Civil War (Spanish: Segunda guerra civil hondureña), also known as the Reclamation Revolution (Spanish: Revolución Reivindicatoria), was a civil war that took place in Honduras in 1924. This was the first conflict in Honduras where airplanes were used for aerial bombardment, and new war tactics inherited from the First World War were employed.

en.s: Convoy SC 19 was the 19th of the numbered series of World War II slow convoys of merchant ships from Sydney, Cape Breton Island to Liverpool. The trade convoy left Halifax, Nova Scotia on 12 January 1941 and was found by U-boats of the 7th U-boat Flotilla on 29 January. Seven ships were sunk before the convoy reached Liverpool on 2 February.

en.s: The Battle of Stalingrad was a major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II in which Nazi Germany and its Axis allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in southern Russia. Marked by intense close-quarters combat and heavy civilian losses during aerial bombardment, the battle is considered the largest and deadliest urban battle in military history and the deadliest battle in World War II.
en.n: World War II: The Battle of Stalingrad comes to an end when Soviet troops accept the surrender of the last organized German troops in the city.

zh.s: 斯大林格勒战役是第二次世界大战东线的一场重大战役，纳粹德国及其轴心国盟友与苏联争夺俄罗斯南部斯大林格勒（今伏尔加格勒）的控制权。战斗以激烈的近距离交战和空袭造成大量平民伤亡为特点，被认为是军事史上规模最大、伤亡最惨重的城市战，也是第二次世界大战中伤亡最惨重的战役。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：苏军接受城内最后一支有组织德军部队投降，斯大林格勒战役结束。

en.s: Operation Koltso (Operation Ring) was the last part of the Battle of Stalingrad. It resulted in the capitulation of the remaining Axis forces encircled in the city. The operation was likely the largest-scale economy-of-force offensive ever conducted in military history.

zh.s: 环形行动是斯大林格勒战役的最后阶段，最终迫使被包围在城内的轴心国残余部队投降。这次行动可能是军事史上规模最大的兵力节约型攻势。

en.s: The Vistula–Oder offensive (Russian: Висло-Одерская операция, romanized: Vislo–Oderskaya operatsiya) was a Red Army operation on the Eastern Front in the European theatre of World War II in January 1945. The army made a major advance into German-held territory, capturing Kraków, Warsaw, and Poznań. The Red Army had built up their strength around a number of key bridgeheads, with two fronts commanded by Marshal Georgy Zhukov and Marshal Ivan Konev.

zh.s: 维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势是苏联红军于1945年1月在第二次世界大战欧洲东线展开的军事行动。红军大举推进至德军控制区，攻占克拉科夫、华沙和波兹南。此前，红军已在若干重要桥头堡集结兵力，两个方面军分别由格奥尔基·朱可夫元帅和伊万·科涅夫元帅指挥。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on February 2, 1958. Mario Echandi Jiménez of the National Union Party won the presidential election, whilst the National Liberation Party won the parliamentary election. Voter turnout was 64.7%. Echandi had become leader of the Opposition as he was elected congressman in 1953. During the tense invasion of 1955 when former president Rafael Angel Calderon's supporters and their international allies tried to invade Costa Rica’s territory and were successfully repelled by José Figueres’ government, Echandi was accused of been Calderonista and been offered an office as minister from Calderón.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1958年2月2日举行大选。民族联盟党的马里奥·埃昌迪·希门尼斯赢得总统选举，民族解放党则赢得议会选举，投票率为64.7%。埃昌迪于1953年当选国会议员，随后成为反对派领袖。1955年局势紧张，前总统拉斐尔·安赫尔·卡尔德隆的支持者与境外盟友试图入侵哥斯达黎加，被何塞·菲格雷斯政府击退。当时埃昌迪被指属于卡尔德隆派，并曾获卡尔德隆许诺出任部长。

en.s: The Ramsar Convention on Wetlands of International Importance Especially as Waterfowl Habitat is an international treaty for the conservation and sustainable use of Ramsar sites (wetlands). en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 2 February 1975 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities. en.s: Cebu Pacific Flight 387 was a domestic flight from Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Metro Manila to Lumbia Airfield (formerly Lumbia Airport) in Cagayan de Oro. On February 2, 1998, the 30-year-old McDonnell Douglas DC-9-32 crashed on the slopes of Mount Sumagaya in Claveria. All 104 people on board died in the crash. It is the second deadliest air disaster in the Philippines after Air Philippines Flight 541, which occurred two years later.

en.s: Costa Rica held parliamentary and presidential elections on Sunday, 2 February 2014 to elect a new president, two vice presidents, and 57 Legislative Assembly lawmakers. Voting is compulsory in Costa Rica, nevertheless abstentionism was 35 percent in 2006 and 32 percent in 2010. In accordance with Article 132 of the Constitution, the incumbent President, Laura Chinchilla Miranda, was ineligible to run for a second consecutive term. The ruling party before the election, the centrist National Liberation Party, put forward San José Mayor Johnny Araya Monge as its presidential candidate. The Libertarian Movement party nominated former legislator Otto Guevara Guth.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on February 2, 2014, with a second round held on March 9 since no candidate won an outright majority. The primary candidates were Vice-President Salvador Sánchez Cerén of the FMLN, San Salvador Mayor Norman Quijano of ARENA, and Former President Antonio "Tony" Saca. Saca represented GANA, the National Conciliation Party, and the Christian Democratic Party in the UNIDAD coalition. Incumbent President Mauricio Funes is ineligible to run for a consecutive second term. Sánchez Cerén and Quijano emerged as the contestants in the runoff held on March 9 in which Sánchez Cerén was declared the victor despite Quijano's charges of irregularities.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于2014年2月2日举行总统选举，因无人获得过半选票，又于3月9日举行第二轮投票。主要候选人包括法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线的副总统萨尔瓦多·桑切斯·塞伦、民族主义共和联盟的圣萨尔瓦多市长诺曼·基哈诺，以及前总统安东尼奥·“托尼”·萨卡。萨卡代表由民族团结大联盟、民族和解党和基督教民主党组成的团结联盟参选。现任总统毛里西奥·富内斯不能连续连任。桑切斯·塞伦与基哈诺进入3月9日的第二轮投票，最终桑切斯·塞伦被宣布获胜，尽管基哈诺指控选举存在违规。

en.t: 2019 President of the Federal Senate of Brazil election

en.t: The Burmese military establishes the State Administration Council, the military junta, after deposing the democratically elected government in the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état
en.s: The State Administration Council (Burmese: နိုင်ငံတော်စီမံအုပ်ချုပ်ရေးကောင်စီ; abbreviated SAC or နစက) was a military junta that governed Myanmar from 2021 to 2025, established by Commander-in-Chief of Defence Services Min Aung Hlaing following the February 2021 coup d'état and the declaration of a state of emergency by the National Defence and Security Council (NDSC). Under the constitution, the Commander-in-Chief holds absolute legislative, executive, and judicial power during a state of emergency.

zh.t: 缅甸军方在2021年政变后成立国家管理委员会
zh.s: 国家管理委员会（缅甸语：နိုင်ငံတော်စီမံအုပ်ချုပ်ရေးကောင်စီ，简称SAC或နစက）是2021年至2025年统治缅甸的军政府，由国防军总司令敏昂莱在2021年2月政变及国防与安全委员会宣布国家进入紧急状态后成立。根据宪法，国家处于紧急状态时，国防军总司令拥有立法、行政和司法的绝对权力。
